comment: A demo is an interactive or visual example that shows the capabilities or features of a product or concept. It is often used to persuade, educate, or test ideas before full implementation.
name: Demo
description: Demo is a shortened form of "demonstration" and refers to a brief presentation or example that illustrates how something works or what it looks like. It is commonly used in technology, education, and marketing to showcase a product, feature, or concept. A demo can be live, recorded, or interactive, and it often serves as a proof of concept or a teaching aid. By providing a tangible or visual representation, demos help users understand functionality without needing to engage with the full system.
sentencesExemples: The new software company held a Demo to showcase its latest app to potential investors.
During the workshop, the instructor ran a Demo to explain how the algorithm works step by step.
After the product launch, the marketing team posted a short Demo video on social media to attract early adopters.
